title: Anti-Counterfeiting Trade Agreement
summary: Wikidata item Q192135, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "multinational intellectual property rights treaty". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.

retraction.reason: Retracted in M42 batch 8 under brief §1: the record earns no honest edge, and it carries no lane either — the item gives no point and names no country, so the timeline has nothing to draw it in. This atlas holds no record of trade law or of intellectual property, and nothing read here argues a line from one it does hold. It waits on a record of the trade order the agreement belongs to.
